channel.title: BBC Good Food - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from BBC Good Food (bbcgoodfood.com)

item.title: Smoky citrus & chipotle pulled pork
item.description: Serve this punchy pulled pork in so many ways – try it in buns, wraps and jacket potatoes. It’s a great recipe to prepare in batches to freeze and cook later

item.title: Sticky sesame, soy & honey chicken
item.description: Prep this sticky chicken in a slow cooker at lunchtime, then serve for dinner with rice or noodles. It's a brilliant hands-off supper

item.title: Giant sausage, harissa & apricot plait
item.description: Planning a day out? Bake, cool and wrap up this fruity sausage roll to keep hunger pangs at bay. It's a perfect pack-and-go snack for the family

item.title: Baked trout with gnocchi & Dijon cream
item.description: Make this speedy, creamy fish dish with trout instead of salmon – it's a more sustainable option than salmon and is usually a little cheaper, too

item.title: Simnel focaccia
item.description: Try this special simnel cake version of a sweet focaccia. It's fluffy, buttery and gently spiced with pockets of melted marzipan and dried fruit in the dough

item.title: Creamy coconut dumpling traybake
item.description: Try our take on the viral dumpling traybake – it's the ideal dinner when you need something on the table quickly. Serve over noodles or sticky rice

item.title: Chipotle soup with chive crème fraîche & crispy lime chickpeas
item.description: Be sure to add the chickpea topping to this chipotle soup – it boosts the flavour and adds crunchy texture, too. Enjoy with crusty bread or tortilla chips

item.title: Lasagne primavera
item.description: Celebrate spring with a veggie lasagne made with spinach, peas, asparagus and leeks. Top with pine nuts for added texture

item.title: Banana bread hot cross buns with whipped banana & honey butter
item.description: Use the ripest, blackest bananas you possibly can for these hot cross buns. Don't skip making the banana butter either – it really does make them special

item.title: Rhubarb, almond & custard sponge pudding
item.description: Celebrate rhubarb with a moreish sponge pudding with custard and almond flavours. Enjoy with ice cream or double cream for a crowd-pleasing comfort dessert
